concerns.text: FR-012 is not covered by any task. The specification requires computing the maximum derivative (inflection point) for every stress curve, but no task explicitly implements this calculation.
FR-022 (phoneme‑level fallback metric) is never implemented. The spec mandates a fallback to phoneme edit‑distance when SSS fails, yet no task creates or runs this metric.
The implementation plan lists several contracts (e.g., `contracts/stress_curve.schema.yaml`, `contracts/collapse_point.schema.yaml`). No task in any phase creates or validates these contract files.

SC-004 (pipeline must complete within 48 h on the free‑tier runner) is not validated by any task. Existing safety‑gate tasks enforce CPU usage and memory limits but do not measure or enforce the overall runtime deadline.

While T053 performs sensitivity analysis, it does not explicitly compute or store the maximum derivative (inflection point) required by FR-012; the task should be split or extended to include that calculation.
SC-001 (regression R² ≥ 0.6) is only implied by T026a/b producing `regression_results.json`. No dedicated task evaluates the R² against the success threshold and flags failure.
FR-011 amendment is documented (T050g) but the constitution requires formal approval of spec amendments. No task records the amendment approval workflow or updates the constitution version.
SC-001 also requires reporting of final sample size; T059 reports size but does not cross‑validate against the power analysis required by FR-023.
FR-017 (log warning for missing distortion scenarios) is partially addressed, but there is no separate task that aggregates and reports all missing scenario warnings in the final report.
FR-026 (audit logging of all intermediate values) is referenced in many tasks, yet no single task ensures a comprehensive audit log is generated and stored per the constitution.
